title: store_snapshot
description: Writes a JPEG of the latest RGB24 frame when a matching event arrives or a snapshot_now command is received, and passes frames through unchanged.

root.description: Directory snapshots are written under; defaults to /Shared/zm/media on macOS, C:/ZM/media on Windows and /lib/zm/media elsewhere.

trigger_types.description: Event types that trigger a snapshot; empty uses the built-in list, and a list like ["none"] means snapshots only on command.

min_interval_ms.description: Minimum time between event-triggered snapshots in milliseconds; negative values are treated as 0.

jpeg_quality.description: FFmpeg JPEG quality scale where lower is better; values outside 2-31 are clamped.

frame_width.description: Width of incoming RGB24 frames; snapshots fail while this is 0.

frame_height.description: Height of incoming RGB24 frames; snapshots fail while this is 0.

stream_filter.description: Stream ids to snapshot; empty accepts all streams.
